fix: Activate a skill when manager.status() shows the named server ready; add project (.structured-ai/skills) and user-level skill roots.

title: discussion_start has no budget guard or cancellation and needs no approval
impact: One model call can trigger 150+ LLM requests (real spend on paid providers) that run cancellation cannot interrupt.
fix: Cap personas x rounds via a setting, pass the run AbortSignal and budget tracker, emit per-call telemetry, move the mock switch to test-only injection.

title: No tests for SSRF IPv6 classification, redirect header handling or LSP-shaped rename edits
impact: The high-severity issues above are not caught by CI and the security boundary can regress unnoticed.
fix: Add table-driven classifyAddress tests (all IPv6 embeddings), a local redirect-server test for header stripping, and code_rename tests with LSP-shaped edits and Windows URIs.

title: TOCTOU between boundary check and file open
impact: Race-based workspace escape for reads and writes; realistic because the agent itself launches long-running processes in the root.
fix: Use handle-based operations (fs.open with O_NOFOLLOW, then fstat dev/ino re-check against the validated path), or run all fs tools inside the same OS sandbox as processes.

title: Background sessions are never pruned and unbounded in count
impact: Long-lived serve deployments leak memory; a looping model can exhaust host processes with process_start.
fix: Add max concurrent sessions per project/run, TTL eviction of exited sessions, and kill a run's sessions when the run ends unless explicitly detached.

title: Timeouts and waits from tool arguments are not clamped
impact: Hung agent turns or instantly killed commands depending on model output.
fix: Clamp all duration arguments to configured min/max in one helper, and validate arguments against the tool JSON schema before execution.

title: Truncated reads silently drop unread background output
impact: Agents miss errors in long build/test logs from background processes.
fix: Advance the cursor only by what was actually returned (track char offsets), expose 'more_available', and optionally return an interleaved combined stream.

title: Windows shell defaults to cmd.exe with no shell selection; POSIX uses arbitrary $SHELL
impact: Unreliable command execution on Windows and on hosts with a non-POSIX login shell.
fix: Add a shell setting/argument (pwsh|powershell|cmd|bash|sh), default to /bin/sh on POSIX and pwsh on Windows, and state OS and shell in the tool description.

title: fs_read / fs_info read whole files into memory with no size limit or file-type check
impact: Multi-GB logs or datasets can OOM the runtime; reading a FIFO hangs the tool forever.
fix: Require stats.isFile(); add MAX_READ_BYTES and stream line ranges (readline) for offset/limit/tail; cap fs_read_many count and concurrency.

title: CRLF files: fs_edit fails to match and fs_read leaves \r in lines
impact: Code editing is unreliable on Windows: the primary edit tool fails on most files.
fix: Detect EOL and BOM (logic already exists in analyseText), normalise to \n for matching, and re-apply the original EOL and BOM on write; add Windows-style fixtures to tests.

title: Writes are non-atomic, unserialised and have no undo
impact: A crash or concurrent edit corrupts or loses files; no rollback for a bad agent edit beyond git.
fix: Write to a sibling temp file and rename (with retry on Windows EPERM), keep per-run checkpoints/undo journal, and serialise mutations per path with a lock plus an optional expected_sha256 precondition.

title: executeTool does not validate arguments, enforce policy, or apply a timeout
impact: Defense-in-depth gap: new entry points (HTTP server, MCP-server mode, plugins) can run fs/process tools without approvals; a hung tool hangs the agent; MCP calls lose project scoping.
fix: Make executeTool the policy choke point: JSON-schema validation (ajv), PolicyEngine check and approval hook, AbortSignal plus timeout, and pass ToolContext to MCP execution.

title: Telemetry records full tool arguments, including file contents and stdin
impact: Secrets and large payloads end up in telemetry/runtime_stats and possibly logs; memory growth.
fix: Redact or omit large and sensitive fields and size-cap argument snapshots before recording.

title: Missing tests for the dangerous paths
impact: The highest-severity defects above are unguarded and regressions will be silent.
fix: Add unit tests for a pure bwrap argv builder and lstat-based boundary fixtures, a Linux CI job with bubblewrap, and a windows-latest CI job running the fs/process suites.

title: Reopening a session with no run_ids pulls every event in the event store into it
impact: Opening an older or empty session that has no run-tagged events backfills every stored event from all sessions and projects. The timeline is wrong, other projects' events show up, and a large store causes heavy memory and CPU use. The merged events then go out to every SSE client through the snapshot.
fix: When run_ids is empty, backfill nothing. Query the store by run_id (and project) instead of loading everything. Cap the backfill size.

title: One failure in startTask's finally block skips the approval sweep, the run:status event and the session save
impact: If the event store flush fails (disk full, Windows file lock), or the plan summary or project context throws, the remaining cleanup never runs. The UI stays in 'running', approvals stay pending forever, and the rejection is swallowed by `startTask(...).catch(() => {})`, so nobody sees it.
fix: Put each cleanup step in its own try/catch, or move the approval sweep and run:status emission into an inner finally. Log swallowed errors through observability instead of `.catch(() => {})`.

title: Every message, thinking chunk and model response rewrites the whole session file synchronously
impact: Write amplification on the event loop that grows as O(n^2) over long runs, which slows SSE delivery. On Windows, antivirus and indexer file locks during rapid rewrites can cause EBUSY or EPERM errors, which are swallowed by the bare `catch {}`.
fix: Debounce or coalesce saves (for example every 1 to 2 seconds plus on run end), write atomically (temp file then rename, with retry on EPERM for Windows), append messages and events as JSONL instead of rewriting, and keep the in-memory events capped.

title: SSE writes ignore backpressure, and every connect or reconnect resends the full snapshot
impact: Memory grows without bound on the server while a browser tab is throttled or backgrounded, or behind a slow proxy. Reconnect storms resend up to MAX_CONSOLE_EVENTS events per client and repeat disk I/O.
fix: Track res.writableLength. Drop or disconnect clients above a threshold, or queue with a cap. Emit `id: <seq>` and replay from Last-Event-ID. Build the snapshot once per request and cache the session list.

title: No security headers (CSP, nosniff, frame-ancestors) on console responses
impact: The console renders untrusted LLM and tool output and controls shell and MCP execution. Without a CSP, any DOM-XSS slip (see the visualizer finding) becomes full control-plane takeover. Without frame-ancestors, a cross-origin page can frame the console for clickjacking ('Approve' buttons). The `?token=` launch URL can leak through the Referer header to external markdown links (target=_blank links are noreferrer, but other navigations are not).
fix: Add a default header set: `Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'`, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`. After exchanging the URL token for the cookie, redirect to strip `?token=`.

title: The visualizer injects symbol names from the indexed repo into innerHTML (DOM XSS)
impact: An indexed repository, or anything the agent writes to the index, can contain a file or directory name or symbol such as ``. The payload runs in the console origin with the HttpOnly cookie attached to its fetch() calls. It can then approve tools, add MCP servers and so on. With no CSP there is no second line of defence.
fix: Build the spans with textContent (the app already has dom.create()). Add a lint rule that bans innerHTML with template literals. Apply the CSP above.

title: The visualizer shows hard-coded demo data whenever the API fails, and the server ignores neighborhood and impact queries
impact: Users see a code graph that does not belong to their project, and focus and impact analysis silently return unrelated data. This is misleading for an observability tool.
fix: Remove the fallback data, or show it only behind an explicit 'demo' flag, and show the real error. Implement the neighborhood and impact views server-side (BFS over the call and dependency graphs), or return 400 for unknown views.

title: The modular WebServer is a facade: all 46 routes forward to a 3,000-line god function
impact: Two routing layers that disagree (the Router decodes params and throws; the implementation decodes again). Auth is enforced inconsistently per branch, which is the root cause of the authz findings above. The web layer is hard to test or extend with the tools the goal needs (terminal stream, file browser, browser-tool viewer, provider config).
fix: Move each route into its controller with a shared middleware chain (rate limit, origin, authenticate, then authorize by declared route permission in RouteInventory, then handler). Then delete the forwarding path. Add a per-route test that checks auth is enforced for every RouteInventory entry.

title: No tests for malformed input, scoped-token authorization on control routes, or SSE backpressure
impact: The critical crash and escalation findings above would not be caught. Regressions in tenancy enforcement on settings, approvals, MCP and sessions go unnoticed.
fix: Add a table-driven test over RouteInventory: for each route, check expected status for no token, read-scoped token, write-scoped token on another project, and master. Add fuzz cases for bad percent-escapes and Host headers, and an SSE slow-client test.

title: Scoped console token lookup is a non-constant-time object key lookup, and an invalid AGENT_CONSOLE_TOKENS JSON is silently ignored
impact: Scoped tokens are compared via hash-map lookup (theoretical timing side channel); a typo in AGENT_CONSOLE_TOKENS disables all scoped tokens silently, which is hard to diagnose. Tokens are stored in plaintext in settings.
fix: Store SHA-256 hashes of scoped tokens, hash the supplied token and compare with timingSafeEqual over each entry; validate AGENT_CONSOLE_TOKENS at startup and surface errors; cache the parsed map, invalidated on the settings 'change' event.

title: --until-done SIGINT handler cannot force-quit and --max-cycles 0 is ignored
impact: If cancellation hangs (stuck HTTP request or child process), the user cannot exit with Ctrl-C; invalid limits are accepted silently.
fix: Second Ctrl-C within 2s forces exit after best-effort shutdown; validate --max-cycles / --max-rounds against schema ranges in ArgParser.

title: ArgParser rejects any value beginning with '-' and has no '--' end-of-options marker
impact: Tasks starting with a dash (e.g. `agent "-- fix the build"` or `agent "- list files"`), API keys or file names starting with '-' cannot be passed; no `--key=value` syntax either.
fix: Support `--` to end option parsing and `--flag=value`; only reject values that are themselves known flags.

title: Secret masking reveals 4 characters and secrets can be persisted into the repo
impact: Known key prefixes (sk-, sk-ant-) plus last 2 chars reduce entropy little but aid identification in screenshots; enabling PROJECT_SAVE_SECRETS commits API keys to git if .agent is not ignored.
fix: Mask as fixed '••••' + last 4 only for long keys; store secrets only in the user-level data home or OS keychain, never in the workspace file; auto-add .agent/ to .gitignore.

title: Dead/duplicated CLI modules: RunCommand and InputReader are unused; task-reading logic duplicated
impact: Tests (test/cli/modules.test.js) lock seams that production does not use, so behaviour can diverge; fixes must be made twice.
fix: Route the one-shot path through RunCommand and the REPL through InputReader; extract a shared resolveTask(options).

title: Windows/macOS path comparison makes repository.is_workspace_root wrong
impact: On Windows the model is always told the workspace is not the repo root, and on macOS temp/symlinked dirs likewise; prompts and git tools may then use wrong relative paths.
fix: Compare path.resolve(fs.realpathSync.native(a)) to path.resolve(fs.realpathSync.native(b)), case-insensitively on win32.

title: Registry signature recomputed (stat of every registry/tool-schema file) on every accessor call
impact: Hundreds of synchronous fs.stat calls per iteration; noticeable on Windows/AV-scanned or network drives and adds event-loop latency under concurrency.
fix: Throttle signature checks (e.g. at most once per second or once per iteration) or use fs.watch with debounce to mark the cache dirty.

title: Schema degradation is process-global, permanent, and ineffective under RESPONSE_FORMAT_MODE=always
impact: A single transient gateway 500 that mentions the schema disables structured output for that endpoint for the life of a long-running web server; with 'always' the retry is wasted and the run fails.
fix: Give degraded entries a TTL, scope by provider+model, and skip the retry when the mode is 'always'; expose the degraded set in the console with a reset action.

title: Native tool calls are ignored when content is also valid JSON
impact: A model that emits both a JSON 'final'/'data' blob in content and native tool_calls (seen with some Qwen/DeepSeek/Gemini compat endpoints) has its tool calls silently dropped, or the content fails validation while valid tool calls existed.
fix: When message.tool_calls is non-empty and content does not validate as an action envelope, prefer the native tool calls; log the conflict as a response:repaired event.

title: Malformed-response notice re-sends full canonical examples and up to 2.4k chars of rejected output every retry
impact: Several KB of tokens appended per malformed answer; with MAX_MALFORMED_RESPONSES retries per code and codes resetting the counter, context grows quickly for weak models and can push into compaction.
fix: Send only closest_valid_shape plus the specific error on the first retry, and remove previous malformed notices/rejected answers from history once a valid action arrives.

title: Duplicate entry-point/lifecycle logic; application layer's fallback path is dead and mis-bound
impact: Two diverging implementations of startup/shutdown; fixes applied to lifecycle.js (e.g. a Windows-friendly shutdown) never take effect, and the fallback would leave modular runs uncancelled on SIGINT.
fix: Delete agent.js main(), have the application layer own the lifecycle, and pass cancelAllRuns in bind().

title: Signal handling is POSIX-centric; Windows service/terminal shutdown paths are not handled
impact: On Windows, closing the console window (SIGHUP) or Ctrl+Break (SIGBREAK) or a service stop does not cancel runs or kill background processes/MCP children, leaving orphaned shells and servers; the 2 s hard exit can also truncate the event store flush.
fix: Add SIGBREAK/SIGHUP handlers on win32, await an async shutdown (kill process trees via taskkill /T on Windows), flush the event store, then exit.

title: Backoff sleep between model retries ignores run cancellation
impact: Cancel/interrupt from the console or a deadline does not take effect until the sleep finishes; up to 30 s per pending agent of unresponsiveness.
fix: Use timers/promises setTimeout(delay, undefined, { signal: currentRun().controller.signal }) and translate the AbortError into the run-cancelled error.

title: API key defaults to a placeholder and is sent to any configured base URL; base URLs are exposed to the model
impact: Misconfiguration silently sends a fake key (confusing 401s), the same key is forwarded to every role endpoint that inherits it (e.g. a key for a paid provider forwarded to a local/third-party summary endpoint), and internal gateway URLs (which may embed tokens or internal hostnames) leak into provider logs.
fix: Treat an unset key as 'no Authorization header', require explicit per-endpoint keys when the base URL host differs from the main one, and strip base_url (or reduce to host/provider name) from runtime_context.

title: No streaming and no response-size bound on model calls
impact: Long generations show nothing until complete and are vulnerable to proxy idle timeouts; a misbehaving endpoint returning a large HTML error page floods errors, logs and events.
fix: Support SSE streaming in the provider adapter (emit agent:delta events), cap body size, and truncate error previews like the non-OK branch already does (slice(0,300)).

title: Strict response schema uses keywords some strict-mode providers do not support
impact: Depending on provider, the schema may be rejected (then permanently degraded) or ignored, so the 'strict' mode does not give the guarantees it advertises on non-OpenAI providers.
fix: Generate provider-specific schema variants from one source of truth and test each against the provider's supported subset; rely on the validator for minLength/minItems.

title: Non-atomic, unlocked read-modify-write of .agent/mcp.json
impact: Concurrent mcp_add from parallel sub-agents, or a crash mid-write, can lose servers or corrupt the file, which silently disables all workspace servers.
fix: Write to a temp file and rename atomically, and serialize writes with an in-process mutex plus a lock file.

title: tools/list_changed does not refresh the manager catalogue; runtime toggles are lost on reload
impact: New or removed server tools are invisible (or stale) to the model for up to 5 minutes. A server disabled from the console can come back after any settings change.
fix: Emit an event from McpClient on list_changed that makes the manager re-list that server. Persist enable/disable state as an override layer, and drop the dead size check.

title: Per-manager settings listeners leak and are never removed
impact: Long-lived multi-project servers accumulate listeners (eventually a MaxListenersExceededWarning) and keep dead managers reachable. Those then reopen configs on settings changes.
fix: Store the handler and remove it in shutdown(). Alternatively, have the registry subscribe once and fan out to its instances.

title: Tool results lose non-text content (images, resources) whenever text is present
impact: Screenshot-producing tools (browser/Playwright MCP, chart tools) lose their images, so multimodal LLMs cannot see them.
fix: Return a normalized content array ({type,text|data,mimeType|uri}) and let the LLM adapter map images to provider-specific image parts.

title: semantic.js uses blocking execSync('which/where') on the request path
impact: The event loop is blocked for tens to hundreds of ms per run start (worse on Windows, where `where` is slow), which stalls every concurrent run and the web UI.
fix: Resolve the binary asynchronously once with a PATH scan in JS, cache it, and invalidate it only on SEMANTIC_ENGINE_BIN changes.

title: Duplicate readDay definitions in EventStoreRepository (dead, shadowed code)
impact: Misleading for maintainers; the first version (whole-file read, ignores root) never runs; no-redeclare lint would fail.
fix: Delete the first definition and enable ESLint no-redeclare in CI.

title: Case-insensitive boundary comparison is assumed for all of macOS (fail-open on case-sensitive volumes)
impact: On a case-sensitive APFS volume (or Windows per-directory case sensitivity/WSL), a sibling directory differing only by case (/Users/a/Proj vs /Users/a/proj) is treated as inside the workspace.
fix: Compare native-realpath results case-sensitively (native realpath already returns stored case) or detect the volume's case sensitivity at startup.

title: Archive maintenance rescans every segment synchronously on each archive call
impact: Compaction latency grows with archive size and blocks the event loop on the long runs the archive exists for.
fix: Track per-segment live counts and byte offsets in the index; compact only when a dead-ratio threshold is crossed.

title: Synchronous listener exceptions propagate into emit() callers
impact: A buggy UI/SSE/plugin listener crashes the agent loop at the emit site; >64 listeners trigger MaxListenersExceeded warnings.
fix: Dispatch through a guarded wrapper (catch + log per listener) and fan out to SSE clients from a single listener.

title: Journal attribution state leaks and mixes concurrent runs
impact: Aborted runs and never-ending tools leak memory in long-lived servers; un-correlated events of an older concurrent run are attributed to the newest run's task/model.
fix: Expire buckets via TTL/LRU and on abort; require run_id for modular runs instead of the ambient STATE fallback.

title: Data home uses ~/.local/share on every OS and ignores XDG_DATA_HOME
impact: Non-idiomatic on Windows (%LOCALAPPDATA%) and macOS (~/Library/Application Support); ignores XDG conventions on Linux.
fix: Use env-paths-style resolution per OS with a one-time migration from the old path.

title: safeId maps distinct ids to the same file and allows Windows-invalid names
impact: Session/journal file collisions between distinct ids; on Windows names like 'con.json' or trailing-dot names are unreliable.
fix: Reject ids that are not already safe, or append a short hash of the original; block reserved Windows names and leading/trailing dots.

title: Policy validator doesn't check rule shape: tools+groups together, unknown keys, non-array agents/argument_absent
impact: Policy typos turn into rules that silently never match or match too broadly. That's a problem for a system meant to be configured by end users.
fix: Validate policy.json against a strict JSON Schema (additionalProperties:false). Treat tools and groups as a union, or reject rules that use both.

title: Approval handler is a process-global singleton, and non-boolean answers count as approval
impact: Embedding several sessions in one process (multi-user web, tests, a future API server) sends every approval to whichever front end registered last. A handler with a bug can approve by accident.
fix: Make the handler per-engine or per-run, routed through RunManager context. Require `answer === true` (strict boolean) and log any other value as an error.

title: Pending web approvals have no timeout and leak when onRequest throws; IDs are predictable
impact: A run with no cancellation signal, or a run whose operator walked away, blocks forever while holding its concurrency slot. Orphaned pending entries keep appearing in the UI. Sequential, guessable IDs make it easier for any client that can reach /api/approvals/:id to answer approvals it shouldn't.
fix: Add APPROVAL_TIMEOUT_MS that auto-denies on expiry, wrap onRequest in try/catch with cleanup, generate IDs with crypto.randomUUID(), and authenticate/authorize the approval endpoint per session.

title: argument_matches regexes are recompiled on every evaluation and stringify non-string args
impact: There's a small CPU cost on every tool call. More importantly, rules can't reliably inspect nested or array arguments such as MCP tool arguments or git_add paths, so policy authors can't write precise rules.
fix: Compile regexes once in PolicyRegistry.reload and cache them. Define semantics for arrays (match any element) and objects (match JSON, or require a path into them).

title: ApprovalStore exposes its internal history array, and errors are swallowed in project lookups
impact: Audit data can be changed by consumers. Runtime wiring bugs are hidden: a failed project lookup silently disables gateway caching and project attribution instead of surfacing.
fix: Return a copy (or a frozen copy). Narrow the catches to MODULE_NOT_FOUND and log anything else.

title: ensureFinalReport throws away a string final_report
impact: When a model returns final_report as a plain string, which is common, the real synthesis is replaced with boilerplate. The user loses the only output they see.
fix: If typeof parsed.final_report === 'string', use it as the summary. Normalize agreed_points/unresolved/next_steps to arrays.

title: Live reload is non-atomic: a half-written registry file throws mid-run, and the mtime/size stamp can miss edits
impact: Saving a file from an editor that writes in place, or a same-size edit within the filesystem's mtime resolution (coarse on FAT, SMB or some Windows setups), either crashes the next tool decision or is not picked up.
fix: Keep the last valid registry snapshot, and on parse or validation failure log the error and keep serving the old snapshot. Add a content hash to the signature for small files, or use fs.watch with debounce.

title: Transcript project isolation leaks legacy documents, and list() parses every transcript in full
impact: Transcripts can cross project boundaries when the legacy data root is shared. The listing endpoint slows down linearly with transcript size and count.
fix: When context.projectId is set, require document.project_id === context.projectId. Keep a small index file (id, project_id, status, timestamps) updated on save for listing.

title: Loop detector treats empty or failed responses as repetition, and can crash on non-string content
impact: When a provider returns empty content (refusals, content filters, errors coerced to ''), the discussion is marked 'loop_detected' and finished early. A custom llmCaller returning undefined content throws a TypeError.
fix: Coerce content with String(x || ''), skip empty messages in the similarity calculation, and require a minimum token count. Consider an embedding-based similarity as planned.

title: File-based skill 'ui_ux_pro_max' is isolated from the skills.json registry and is not cross-validated
impact: A typo in a file-based skill's tool list or resource path only shows up when the skill is used. There are two skill systems with different capabilities.
fix: Merge both sources into one SkillRegistry (registry entries plus discovered skill.json), validate tool names and check that resource paths stay inside the skill directory, and allow agents to reference discovered skills.

title: Retry-After parsing handles only delta-seconds; 409 treated as retryable
impact: Providers that send an HTTP-date Retry-After (allowed by RFC 9110) get ignored; Anthropic/OpenRouter-specific headers (retry-after-ms, x-ratelimit-reset-*) are not honoured, increasing 429 storms. Retrying 409 on non-idempotent semantics can duplicate work.
fix: Parse HTTP-date via Date.parse, support retry-after-ms and provider reset headers in the transport adapter, and make the retryable status set provider-configurable (drop 409 by default).

title: Unknown action outcome silently burns an iteration
impact: If the parser ever lets an unexpected action through (new action types, provider-specific outputs), the model receives the identical context again and the loop can spin until MAX_ITERATIONS with no feedback.
fix: Treat 'unknown' as a model-response error: push a malformedNoticeMessage (or throw an INVALID_ACTION modelResponseError) so the malformed budget applies.

title: Project health is permanently 'degraded' after any single error
impact: Health endpoints become meaningless in long-lived processes (one transient MCP timeout -> degraded forever); unbounded per-project buckets leak memory in multi-tenant use.
fix: Use a sliding window / error-rate with timestamps, clear last_error after N successful runs or a TTL, and LRU-bound the project map. Expose metrics in Prometheus/OpenTelemetry format instead of ad-hoc counters.

title: Process-global engine host prevents multiple engines / isolated tests
impact: Only one agent configuration (one LLM transport, one tool runtime, one policy engine) can exist per Node process; embedding structured-ai as a library or running provider-specific engines side by side is impossible, and a bad bind fails late with 'not bound'.
fix: Turn the loop modules into a class/factory createEngine(host) that closes over its host; keep the global as a thin legacy shim. Throw on invalid bind input.

title: Duplicated malformed-response handling diverges from RetryController.noteMalformed
impact: Behaviour drift between main and sub agents (e.g. sub-agents never get wrap-up notices near the deadline, so they keep working until the hard deadline kills the run).
fix: Extract a single runAgentLoop(kind, hooks) with shared malformed handling via noteMalformed, and apply wrap-up notices to sub-agents too.

title: Unbounded growth of RunManager.issued for runs that never execute
impact: Slow memory leak in a long-running gateway; ids are also time-derived and predictable (run-<ISO time>), which matters if run ids are used as capability handles in an HTTP API.
fix: Use crypto.randomUUID() for run ids (keep the timestamp only as a display field) and drop the issued set, or expire issued entries.

title: Delegation fallback policy ignores missing max_children
impact: A misconfigured profile can fan out an unlimited number of children in one action (bounded only by the total agent budget), contradicting the documented per-agent limit.
fix: Default max_children to settings MAX_PARALLEL_AGENTS when not a finite number; validate agent profiles at registry load.

title: Argument reference to a known call not in depends_on fails the call
impact: Writing JS/shell templates is fragile (generated ids call_1..N are very likely to collide with template literals); the model gets a confusing error and may loop.
fix: Use a distinct reference syntax (e.g. {{ref:call_1.result}}) or only treat ids in depends_on as references; leave everything else literal.

title: `npm run check` syntax-checks a single file
impact: The CI 'Syntax check' step gives a false sense of coverage. Syntax errors in lazily-required modules surface only at runtime or in whichever test happens to load them.
fix: Add ESLint (flat config, no-undef, no-unused-vars, node globals) or at least a script that runs `node --check` over every .js file under agent/, bin/ and web/. Run it in CI.

title: e2e tests leak temp workspaces and stub servers on failure
impact: Every failing assertion leaves an agent-e2e-* directory, sometimes holding a 40KB bulk.txt and .agent state. Under flaky conditions, CI runners and dev machines accumulate garbage. An unhandled rejection in main() crashes with a stack trace and no summary.
fix: Wrap each test body in try/finally (or use t.after() in node:test) and register cleanup when the resource is created. Add `main().catch(e => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); })` everywhere.

title: Stale and broken documentation links and figures
impact: Onboarding cost and loss of trust. Contributors cannot find the design docs, and the pass counts cannot be verified.
fix: Fix the relative links (../EXECUTION_PLAN.md) or drop the missing ones. Generate test counts from CI. Add an English README, since the primary docs are Persian-only, which limits outside contributors.

title: Scratch artefacts are present in the source tree despite .gitignore
impact: Repo bloat and duplicate package.json/Dockerfile copies that tooling may pick up (e.g. a recursive glob for tests or package manifests). Ignoring after the fact does not untrack files.
fix: `git rm -r --cached tmp-baseline` and move the screenshots to docs/. Add a `files` allowlist (or .npmignore) for packaging.

title: Search sessions: running ones never pruned, limits and wait unbounded
impact: A model can start many long searches that hold memory/CPU indefinitely; a huge wait_ms blocks the tool call.
fix: Cap concurrent running sessions, clamp max_results/max_depth/wait_ms to settings, add a per-session wall-clock deadline.

title: Index session duration and per-engine concurrency are wrong
impact: code_index_get reports a meaningless duration_ms; two indexes of the same project can race on the index files.
fix: Preserve started_at, add finished_at, reject or join a second start for the same engine.

title: mcp_servers returns stale status after refresh; discover errors swallowed
impact: After refresh the model sees the old problem list and cannot tell why discovery failed.
fix: Read status after discover and surface the discover error in the response.

title: plan_set carries progress onto different steps when ids are positional
impact: A rewritten plan may claim unrelated steps are done, causing work to be skipped.
fix: Preserve only for explicit ids (or id+title match) and recompute phase status after merging.

title: Skill cache ignores edits to directory skills
impact: Contradicts the documented hot reload; edited skills serve stale instructions until restart.
fix: Track the mtime (or hash) of each skill.json and handle a missing registry file gracefully.

title: archive_get returns uncapped bodies for an unbounded id list
impact: A single call can push megabytes of archived tool output into the model context unless a later generic cap intervenes.
fix: Cap the id count and per-body/total characters, with offsets for paging.

title: fs_stat/fs_info symlink reporting is dead code; is_symlink is always false
impact: The agent cannot discover symlinks via metadata tools; the existing test (tools.test.js:182 asserts is_symlink false) masks the defect.
fix: Resolve parent-only for metadata tools, lstat the leaf, and report link plus target (with an 'outside workspace' flag rather than leaking the absolute target).

title: UTF-8 multibyte characters corrupted at chunk boundaries; Windows code pages ignored
impact: Garbled non-ASCII output (Persian/CJK file names, compiler messages), especially on Windows.
fix: Use stream.setEncoding('utf8') or StringDecoder; on Windows run cmd with chcp 65001 or prefer PowerShell with UTF-8 output encoding.

title: Windows killTree is fire-and-forget and taskkill spawn errors are unhandled
impact: Orphaned process trees on Windows (dev servers keep ports bound); a missing taskkill.exe on a restricted PATH can crash the runtime.
fix: Attach an 'error' handler to the taskkill child and await its exit; consider Job Objects for reliable tree kill; report 'orphaned' if the tree survives.

title: isInsideRoot fails for filesystem-root workspaces and ignores Windows device/ADS paths
impact: Edge-case denials (container workspaces at /) and Windows reserved-name/ADS confusion.
fix: Special-case filesystem roots; reject Windows reserved device names and ':' outside the drive prefix in resolvePathInRoot.

title: Leading-cd guard is cosmetic and can be mistaken for a boundary
impact: False sense of confinement for shell commands in unsandboxed mode.
fix: Document it as UX-only; real confinement must come from the sandbox provider. Consider turning it into a cwd suggestion instead of an error.

title: The graph builder assumes POSIX paths, so module grouping breaks on Windows indexes
impact: If the indexer stores native Windows paths (`src\\auth\\x.ts`), every file falls into 'root', or one module per file. The architecture view is useless on Windows. I did not verify the indexer's path format.
fix: Normalise with `p.replace(/\\/g, '/')`, or path.posix, before splitting. Add a Windows-path fixture test.

title: The rate limiter keys on the raw socket address and fails open when the key map fills
impact: Behind a reverse proxy, all users share one bucket (self-DoS). An attacker with many source IPs (IPv6) can force clears and reset limits. A browser that reconnects SSE often plus normal polling can reach 120 per minute and get 429s.
fix: Evict expired entries instead of clearing everything. Optionally trust X-Forwarded-For behind a configured proxy. Use separate buckets for auth failures (brute force) and authenticated mutations.

title: Accepting the token in the query string, plus a session cookie with no expiry and no Secure flag
impact: The master token ends up in browser history, proxy and access logs, and shell history. Once leaked, it is valid for the process lifetime and grants RCE (see the MCP finding). If the console is exposed over plain HTTP on a LAN, the cookie travels in clear text.
fix: Accept ?token only on GET / to set the cookie, then 302 to a clean URL. Add Max-Age, add Secure when served over TLS, add token rotation and logout, and document the bind address (default 127.0.0.1).

title: Frontend is a 159 KB single-file console with a non-module global Modal and no frontend tests
impact: Hard to maintain or extend toward an OpenHands-class UI (terminal, editor, browser panes). The safe-by-construction string-to-innerHTML path in Modal is a standing XSS trap for future callers. One malformed SSE frame throws inside onmessage.
fix: Break console.js into the existing module files and delete the duplicates. Make Modal accept only Nodes, or escape strings by default. Guard JSON.parse. Add DOM tests (jsdom) for markdown rendering, link sanitisation and approval flows.
